description: 気象観測_災害をもたらした気象事例(平成元年~本年)1 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Data Catalog Site of the Japanese government (data.go.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 平成元年以降に発生した主な気象災害事例のうち、被害を総合的にみて規模の大きなもの、社会的な関心・影響が高いものについての詳細を掲載しています。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. Its tags are 交通, 公務_他に分類されるものを除く, 地球観測, 気象, 災害. It offers 116 resource(s) in csv, html. The portal shows 2023-05-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-datago-portal.
